# Case 05: coined terms, inconsistent roots, no definition

Skill: all section skills
Expected gates: G-SH-T1, G-SH-T2, G-SH-T3, G-SH-T5, G-SH-T6, G-SH-T7
Language: zh

Snippet:

> 为缓解拥堵，引入接力承接窗机制，这是该领域的常用做法。承继区间的长度由负载决定。承接接力段结束后，机器人返回原位。

Why it fails: three different names stand for one concept, none is defined by function, no literature supports calling it common, and the first one appears as a bare mechanism name.
